comments.author: Stratoscope
comments.story: How RCA Victor sold Sound Service to classrooms in 1939
comments.why: Bell System instructional film introducing dial service
comments.text: The Bell System did this when dial telephone service was first introduced. They held town meetings with a giant rotary dial onstage where someone explained it and demonstrated how to dial your calls. And they made an instructional film about it! [VIDEO]

comments.why: Old straightforward instructional video for contrast
comments.text: I think this “awesome”, “amazing”, “super exciting” phase came much later than the moon walking era. Remember it’s been over 50 years since humans walked on the moon. Much has changed. See these old videos, where people talk in a straightforward way: Car transmission [LINK] How to dial your phone [LINK] The dial comes to town [VIDEO] Now go watch that Apple video again and you’ll see what I’m talking about.
